sentences.en: I was keen on classical music in my school days.
sentences.zh: 我在学生时代对古典音乐很热衷。

sentences.en: I am not keen on anything that is after life.
sentences.zh: 我对任何超自然的事情都不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Flies have a keen sense of smell for decaying matter.
sentences.zh: 苍蝇对于腐烂物质有敏锐的嗅觉。

senses.zh: 敏锐的，敏捷的；渴望的；强烈的；热心的；锐利的
